title: kith-tslocal: whois_cache HashMap grows unboundedly (never pruned)
description: The whois_cache is a HashMap<SocketAddr, (Instant, WhoIsResponse)> that is never pruned. Each new connection arrives on a unique ephemeral port (new SocketAddr key), and expired entries are never evicted. In sustained traffic the HashMap grows monotonically for the process lifetime. At 100 connections/second over 24 hours that is ~8.6M entries / several GB. Fix: before each cache insert, call cache.retain(|_, (t, _)| t.elapsed() < WHOIS_CACHE_TTL) to evict expired entries.
